ceiling_unit_validation.basis: Room ceilingHeight raw2.3/2.6 conflicts with mm schema: literal millimeters cannot contain placed doors height1977/2120/2296/2300mm. Values interpreted as meters per room; no replacement by a generic2.5m or room-type default.

coordinate_transform: source mm -> meters: x=(source_x-origin_x)/1000, z=(source_z-origin_z)/1000; Blender x,-z,height; glTF x,height,z

area_accounting.note: Supply/exclusive areas are source metadata, not floor polygon sums. Exact make_valid area interpretation is separately audited; no fitting or global rescaling applied.

wall_inference.method: outside bands around source interior-face polygons; source inter-room gaps preserved

entrance.identification_basis: source Entrance Door product; interior direction from actual occupied polygon on one sampled side, no assumed cardinal orientation

limitations: Coordinates, ceilings and opening sizes are source model data, not field measurements or confirmed renovation status.
Source positions/opening instance dimensions convert mm to meters without global fitting or arbitrary scaling.
External wall thickness is absent: the0.2m outside band is an explicit modeling assumption.
Per-room raw2.3/2.6 ceiling values are interpreted as meters against placed opening dimensions; no2.5m default override.
Frame thickness, glazing thickness, door leaf offsets and hinge/swing construction are visual assumptions, not product measurements.
Source opening rotations are retained; axis is a compatibility label only, not a cardinal-angle replacement.
Untyped regions use actual source door adjacency for provisional utility/excluded classification; tiny fragments are not walking starts.
Exact make_valid partitions of any invalid polygon are recorded with original coordinates, area and boundary audit; no arbitrary shape correction.
Furniture, fixtures, materials matching and common-core/floor placement are outside this structural shell artifact.
wall_height_policy: per_layer maximum adjacent raw source room height
ceiling_visibility_policy: GLB contains complete ceilings; BLEND viewport/render hides ceilings for review
material_policy: neutral structural preview; source finishes not reconstructed; surface work remains S3
